independent_integrity.timing_definition: query_seconds is observed physical wall. pre_answer_seconds includes selector/packing/compaction; answer_call.wall_seconds plus small logging overhead completes query. tokenize_seconds is nested across these phases, and compaction_seconds includes its tokenizer work: neither is added again.
evidence_limits: Protocol/UTC logs are local mutable evidence, not externally signed preregistration.

Frozen code clears token-count cache at each query; original per-tokenize HTTP payloads/responses are not individually logged, so cache-reset behavior is supported by code and per-query request counts, not a complete tokenization wire trace.
Complete HTTP request payloads and selected response timing fields are saved; full raw server responses are not retained.
C preserves unique raw/import/summary body strings. It changes headers, repetition, grouping and positional presentation; equivalent reasoning behavior is not guaranteed.
New questions reuse six original synthetic projects and summaries. Old questions are explicitly exploratory regression; this is not validation on independent real repositories.

costs.initialization_note: Existing v1 summaries reused. Document vectors timed separately. Historical summary build cost is not full cold-start cost.

measurement_notes: Primary mean_query_seconds is the mean across 48 question-specific median-of-three physical query times.
Request p50/p95 use all 144 observed requests per arm, not question medians.
Prefill + decode + other form a disjoint decomposition of mean request time.
Tokenizer and compaction durations overlap other stages; do not add them to a stacked total.
New means new questions on already seen synthetic projects; no independent repository generalization.
Strict JSON/type/list order scoring remains primary. Order-tolerant diagnostics are supplementary.
Old and new question scores must not be pooled or treated as 96 independent projects.
